incidents.title: Double-click checkout
incidents.brief: A shopper double-clicks Pay and two POSTs create two orders and two charges.
incidents.constraint: The client may retry; the user meant one purchase.
incidents.question: What API property prevents duplicate charges?

choices.label: Idempotency key
choices.resultBody: An idempotency key so the second POST returns the original order instead of a new charge.

choices.label: Disable button
choices.resultBody: The retry ran the money path again.

choices.label: Accept both
choices.resultBody: Accept both POSTs as separate orders
